usercss_import_desc: Add an HTTPS website or an exact stylesheet URL for @import. Resource URLs in url() are limited to api.munetios.com and fonts.googleapis.com.
usercss_import_invalid: Enter a valid HTTPS website or stylesheet URL.
compare_desc: Munetios WebFilter vs. GoGuardian vs. Securly vs. Lightspeed
compare_availability: Availability varies by plan, device, and setup.
collaborator_account_hint: Enter the email address of an existing Munetios account.
collaborator_account_not_found: This email address does not match a Munetios account.
policy_changed: The policy changed on the server. Review the latest policy and apply your edits again.
extension_install_unavailable: This workspace has no published installation package yet.
session_check_failed: Failed to verify your Munetios session.
name: Name
customize_sidebar_desc: Reorder items or hide the ones you don't use. Settings always stays visible.
teacher_notice_body: You can allow and block sites for your classes and change Global rules for them. Other classes aren't affected.
locked_global: Global rules are managed by Admins and are read-only for Teachers
locked_class: You can only change classes assigned to you
locked_device: You can only manage devices in your assigned classes
locked_owner: The workspace owner can't be removed
locked_last_workspace: You need at least one workspace
rules_desc: Block or allow websites for the whole school or for one class.
reason_webfilter_page: The WebFilter block page is always reachable
reason_allowlist_only: Only allowed websites can open (Allowlist only)
reason_open: No rule matches, so the website opens
global_rules_desc: Apply to every class. Teachers can change them for their own class.
class_rules_desc: Your class's own rules. They come first for this class, before Global rules.
delete_rule_confirm: Delete the rule for {pattern}? Devices stop enforcing it at their next sync.
rule_pattern_help: For example, example.org. To block only part of a site, add the page, like example.org/games.
invalid_pattern: Enter a domain, URL, or keyword.
allowlist_only_global_desc: Block every website except the ones allowed by a rule.
allowlist_only_class_desc: Only allowed websites open for this class, for example during a test.
no_class_rules: No rules for this class yet.
no_classes_admin: Create a class to add class rules.
no_classes_teacher: No classes are assigned to you yet. Ask an Admin to assign one.
classes_desc: Group devices by class and choose which Teachers manage each one.
delete_class_confirm: Delete {name}? Its rules and UserCSS are removed, and its devices fall back to Global rules.
usercss_desc: Choose where students' UserCSS is allowed to run.
url_policies_desc: These lists control UserCSS only. They never block access to a website.
unlisted_urls_desc: What happens on websites that aren't in Allowed, Partially blocked, or Blocked.
list_allowed_desc: Full UserCSS runs here, inside the security sandbox.
list_partial_desc: UserCSS loads, but only colors, backgrounds, and text style are kept.
list_blocked_desc: The website loads normally with no UserCSS at all.
inherited_lists_desc: Global lists always apply. When both match, the more restrictive list wins. Global default: {mode}.
mode_allowed_desc: All UserCSS runs, except risky CSS, which is always removed.
mode_partial_desc: Only colors, backgrounds, and text style are kept. Everything else is removed.
mode_blocked_desc: No UserCSS is applied. The website keeps its default look.
mode_restricted_desc: UserCSS never styles WebFilter restricted pages: websites the web filter blocks and the WebFilter block page.
v_escape_obfuscation: CSS escapes are blocked so filters can't be bypassed
v_script_vector: Script execution vector (expression, behavior, -moz-binding, javascript:, vbscript:, data:text/html)
v_partial_property: Property not permitted on Partially blocked URLs
v_external_resource: UserCSS resources must use HTTPS on api.munetios.com or fonts.googleapis.com
v_z_index_indirect: z-index set through var() or calc() can't be checked
v_protected_overlay: Hiding properties on the root element would hide WebFilter notices
v_protected_target: WebFilter block pages, banners, and overlays can't be styled
v_exfiltration: Sensitive input selector combined with a resource load (CSS exfiltration)
v_viewport_overlay: Full-screen fixed or absolute overlay (UI redressing)
v_font_tracking: unicode-range with a file from another website (keystroke tracking)
v_partial_import: @import isn't allowed on Partially blocked URLs
v_external_import: @import must use an approved HTTPS website or stylesheet URL
v_blocked_import: @import must point to an allowed external stylesheet
v_partial_at_rule: This at-rule isn't allowed on Partially blocked URLs
v_restricted_page: This page is blocked by the web filter, so UserCSS is never applied
v_blocked_url_policy: This URL is on the Blocked list, so UserCSS is never applied
devices_desc: Managed devices running the Munetios WebFilter extension. Status updates about every 30 seconds.
no_devices: No devices yet. Install the extension on a device and it shows up here.
server_offline_body: Rules are saved on this device. Reconnect to sync them and manage devices.
no_tabs: This device hasn't reported any open tabs.
invalid_minutes: Enter a number of minutes greater than 0.
no_commands: No commands in the last 24 hours.
remove_device_confirm: Remove {device} from this list? It comes back the next time it checks in.
toast_command_queued: Sent to {device}. It runs at the next check-in.
collaborators_desc: Admins manage the whole organization. Teachers manage only the classes assigned to them.
assigned_classes_help: Teachers can manage these classes. Admins can manage every class.
duplicate_email: Someone with this email is already a collaborator.
last_admin: A workspace needs at least one Admin.
settings_desc: Language, sidebar, workspaces, and the WebFilter server connection.
language_desc: Used in the WebFilter console and on the block page.
sidebar_desc: Choose which sections show in the sidebar and in what order.
new_workspace_desc: Each workspace is a separate organization with its own rules, devices, and extension ID.
delete_workspace_desc: Removes this workspace's rules, classes, and collaborators from this device.
reregister_desc: The server doesn't recognize this workspace. Register it again, then redeploy the extension.
toast_storage_failed: Couldn't save on this device. Check your browser storage.
extension_desc: Install the Munetios WebFilter extension on school Chromebooks and computers so your rules apply there.
block_title: This website has been blocked by your administrator
block_body: Your school's Munetios WebFilter blocked this page.
block_return_body: Go back to the previous page.
block_reason_class: Blocked by a rule for your class
block_reason_allowlist: Only approved websites are allowed right now
block_locked_body: Your teacher or administrator locked this device.
block_notice_body: Your teacher or administrator sent this message.
ext_description: Munetios WebFilter: safe browsing and UserCSS for school devices.
ext_managed_hint: Some settings are set by your administrator.
no_devices_teacher: No devices in your assigned classes yet.
no_classes_page: No classes yet. Add one to group devices and assign Teachers.
blocked_text_desc: Pages whose address contains these words are blocked, and the words are removed when students type or paste them. Websites on an allow rule are exempt.
ext_text_blocked_body: That text isn't allowed by your school's WebFilter, so it was removed.
categories_desc: Block whole categories of websites. Sites that aren't in the category list are Unrated, and you can block Unrated too.
category_source_custom: Custom category set by an Admin
category_source_unrated: Not in the category list, so it defaults to Unrated
builtin_count: {count} well-known sites, plus .edu and .gov addresses, are in the built-in category list. Everything else is Unrated. No website is ever looked up online.
global_categories_desc: Blocked on every managed device. Allow rules still open individual sites.
class_categories_desc: Blocked only for devices in this class, on top of Global.
custom_categories_desc: Put sites in a category, or move a site out of its built-in one. The most specific domain wins.
categorize_sites_help: One domain per line, or separated by commas. Subdomains are included.
rule_patterns_help: Add several at once, one per line. For example, example.org. To block only part of a site, add the page, like example.org/games.
cat_unrated_desc: Every site that isn't in the category list
change_for_class_desc: Your change applies only to {name}. Everyone else keeps the Global rule.
teacher_global_body: Switch a Global rule off, change it, or allow and block sites. Other classes aren't affected.
global_rules_teacher_desc: Rules for the whole school, as your class sees them.
usercss_how_title: Students write UserCSS in the extension
usercss_how_body: Nothing changes on a page until a student turns on Inject UserCSS. These settings decide where it can run.
usercss_how_1: Select the Munetios WebFilter icon in the browser toolbar.
usercss_how_2: Select Edit UserCSS. The editor opens beside the page.
usercss_how_3: Turn on Inject UserCSS to see the styles on the page.
server_online_desc: Rules reach devices within about a minute.
extension_offline_note: Reconnect to get the install link. You can still download the folder.
install_whole_school_desc: Copy these into your admin console. Devices install the extension and check in by themselves.
link_failed: Couldn't get the install link ready
install_google_1: In the Google Admin console, open Devices > Chrome > Apps & extensions > Users & browsers.
install_google_2: Choose your students' organizational unit, then select Add > Add Chrome app or extension by ID.
install_google_3: Paste the Extension ID, choose From a custom URL, and paste the Install URL.
install_google_4: Set it to Force install, then save.
install_m365_1: In the Microsoft Intune admin center, open Devices > Configuration and create a Settings catalog policy for Windows.
install_m365_2: Add Microsoft Edge > Extensions > Control which extensions are installed silently.
install_m365_3: Paste the value shown above as one line.
install_m365_4: Assign the policy to your students' devices, then save.
install_step_1: Download the extension and unzip it into a folder.
install_step_2: Open chrome://extensions or edge://extensions and turn on Developer mode.
install_step_3: Select Load unpacked and choose the folder.
install_step_4: The device shows up in Remote Devices within a minute.
ext_inject_desc: Your styles only run when this is on. Your school decides where UserCSS is allowed.
ext_inject_off_note: Turn on Inject UserCSS to see your styles.
ext_open_site: Open a website to try your styles on it.
ext_no_styles: You don't have any styles yet.
ext_runs_on_help: Websites separated by commas. Leave empty for every website.
ext_picking: Click an element on the page. Press Escape to stop.
ext_pick_failed: Open a website in this window to select an element.
invalid_youtube_video: Enter a valid YouTube video link or 11-character video ID.
locked_device_other: Another Teacher already set this device
locked_managed_class: Your organization manages this device’s class.
device_assignment_changed: This device’s assignment changed. Close this dialog and refresh Remote Devices.
device_class_unavailable: This class is no longer available.
add_device_to_class_desc: The device follows that class's rules. Other Teachers can't move it once you've set it.
screen_waiting: Screen previews may be paused for privacy.
requests_desc: Students can ask for a blocked site from the block page. Approving adds an allow rule.
toast_request_approved: Approved. The student's device opens the site at its next check-in.
request_conflicting_rule: A blocking rule still applies. Update that rule before approving this request.
bypass_desc: Teachers and admins can type this on any block page to open the site on that device for a while.
bypass_on: On · opens a site for {minutes} minutes
bypass_hint: Share it only with staff. Every use is recorded.
bypass_remove_confirm: Remove the bypass password? The Bypass option stops working on block pages.
block_request_reason: Why do you need this site? (optional)
block_bypass_desc: Type the bypass password to open this site on this device for a while.
block_needs_extension: Request access and bypass work on devices with the Munetios WebFilter extension.
block_request_failed: Couldn't send the request. Try again.
block_request_sent: Request sent. This page opens the site by itself if it's approved.
block_bypass_ok: Unlocked for {minutes} minutes. Opening the site…
block_bypass_failed: Couldn't check the password. Try again.
ext_set_by_school: Your school sets these. They can't be changed here.
